source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-stage1-quotient-left-inversion — There is a universal e_H^r > 0 such that, for every finite-dimensional exact-unit epsilon_r-C*-algebra with 0 <= epsilon_r <= e_H^r, the scalar-equivariant mu, sigma and the jointly continuous projected straight paths descend to breve-calU; the descended multiplication makes it a connected H-space, and the descended smooth map breve-sigma is a left inversion.
